Demo Institute of Health Sciences
Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR)
2023-24

Submitted by the Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) to the
council as per the prescribed format.

Criterion 1: Curricular aspects of the affiliated programmes.
Criterion 2: Teaching, learning and evaluation during the year.

The peer team visit documentation is retained by the IQAC for the
accreditation cycle.
